steps.prompt: Does morphology and chronic/relapsing itch fit atopic dermatitis?
Evaluate mimickers: scabies, contact dermatitis, CTCL, psoriasis, immunodeficiency
Honey crusting, pustules, pain, eczema herpeticum concern, or fever?
Treat infection/urgent eczema herpeticum pathway first
BSA, sleep loss, itch, lichenification, and QoL impairment?
Proactive topical therapy, trigger/contact review, phototherapy/systemic discussion if persistent

citations.quote: AAD topical AD guideline: strong recommendations for moisturizers, topical corticosteroids, topical calcineurin inhibitors, and topical PDE-4/JAK inhibitors.
AAD phototherapy/systemic AD guideline addresses AD refractory to topical therapies and recommends systemic/biologic/JAK options.
